title: "Tools & Resources"
pagetitle: "Tools & Resources"
output: html_document
---

Populations, genomes, data and software from the lab and our collaborators.

```{r tools, echo=FALSE, results='asis', warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
# Builds the page from tools.yml (see the comments in that file): a heading for each group,
# then one card per item.
groups <- yaml::yaml.load(paste(readLines("tools.yml", encoding = "UTF-8", warn = FALSE), collapse = "\n"))$groups
esc <- function(x) {
  x <- gsub("&", "&amp;", x, fixed = TRUE)
  x <- gsub("<", "&lt;", x, fixed = TRUE)
  gsub(">", "&gt;", x, fixed = TRUE)
}
# *text* becomes italics, for gene and species names
md <- function(x) gsub("\\*([^*]+)\\*", "<em>\\1</em>", esc(x))
cat("```{=html}\n")
if (length(groups) == 0) {
  cat('<p class="tools-empty">Tools will be listed here soon.</p>\n')
}
for (g in groups) {
  cat(sprintf('<h2 class="tools-group" id="%s">%s</h2>\n', esc(g$id), md(g$title)))
  cat('<div class="tools-grid">\n')
  for (t in g$items) {
    links <- vapply(t$links, function(l)
      sprintf('<a class="tool-link" href="%s">%s</a>', esc(l$url), esc(l$label)), "")
    cat('<article class="tool-card">\n',
        if (!is.null(t$kind)) sprintf('<p class="tool-kind">%s</p>\n', esc(t$kind)) else "",
        sprintf('<h3 class="tool-name">%s</h3>\n', md(t$name)),
        sprintf('<p class="tool-desc">%s</p>\n', md(t$description)),
        if (length(links)) sprintf('<p class="tool-links">%s</p>\n', paste(links, collapse = " ")) else "",
        '</article>\n', sep = "")
  }
  cat("</div>\n")
}
cat("```\n")
```
